dominicanen.name: Dominicanen Bookshop
dominicanen.slogan: Browse novels under a Gothic vault, with a cafe in the choir.
dominicanen.line: Housed in a 13th-century Dominican church, it has been a bookshop since 2006 and topped a 2025 ranking of the world's most beautiful.

helpoort.name: Helpoort
helpoort.slogan: The one city gate Maastricht kept, still guarding Jekerkwartier.
helpoort.line: Permission to build it came from Duke Henry I of Brabant in 1229, making it the oldest surviving city gate in the Netherlands.

servaasbrug.name: Sint Servaasbrug
servaasbrug.slogan: Seven centuries of footsteps between the old town and Wyck.
servaasbrug.line: The stone bridge dates from 1280-1298 and was widened and largely rebuilt in 1932-34; it was called the Maasbrug until 1932.

stservaas.name: Basilica of Saint Servatius
stservaas.slogan: A saint's grave, and a thousand years of Romanesque stone over it.
stservaas.line: Built over the grave of Servatius, who died in Maastricht around 384, it is among the oldest surviving churches in the Netherlands.

bonnefanten.name: Bonnefanten Museum
bonnefanten.slogan: A zinc rocket on the Maas, launched by an Italian architect.
bonnefanten.line: Aldo Rossi's museum opened in 1995, crowned by a zinc-clad dome about 28 metres high above a long central staircase.
